behavior.businessRefresh: Only a newer order watermark or explicit refresh; one in-flight read and coalesced notifications
behavior.gps: Exact latest-point listener updates only coordinates, age and expiry; no business callable
behavior.authority: Current account profile subscription plus current profile/order/assignment rules
behavior.background: Detach state and GPS listeners while hidden or offline; reconnect latest server snapshots and reconcile only newer state
behavior.recovery: Transient transport failures stop automatic recovery; explicit refresh retries. A GPS assignment/terminal denial triggers at most one authority reconciliation per binding.
behavior.privacy: Hide old account/order results, cleared assignments and revoked OTP/GPS. A new assignment point cannot be displayed with the previous driver identity.
behavior.time: Local stale/expiry deadlines do not read the server. A mobile effect that misses a deadline repaints the crossing immediately.

checks: Chrome and iPhone WebKit event/recovery suites
scenarios: one idle hour: one bootstrap and zero periodic reads
20 GPS changes: zero extra order reads
disabled profile and stale successful response
new assignment point before business marker
terminal GPS denial and per-binding retry cap

release.rollback: Roll back frontend consumption with both tracking/dispatch readers before returning to the old RTDB-only location writer.

remaining: Dispatch dashboard still has its separate 30-second refresh and needs state/roster/count/GPS separation
Actual billed savings require production traffic and byte/fan-out measurements; emulator call counts are not a billing estimate
